mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate increases discount rates for equity valuation, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. This mechanism is continuously active without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns show positive correlation with FEDFUNDS (Rank IC > 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 5.0%, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% in 60% of cases but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production and payrolls indicates broad economic contraction, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in INDPRO and PAYEMS occurs in 40% of cases but S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 45% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, declining retail sales (RSAFS) signals impending consumer spending slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: During late-cycle expansions, RSAFS declines occur in 30% of cases but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 35% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index exceeding 210.0 signals persistent inflation that may prompt aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL exceeds 210.0 in 50% of cases but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: A higher unemployment rate continuously signals reduced labor market strength, lowering consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns show positive correlation with UNRATE (Rank IC > 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts and industrial production indicates weakening in housing sector and manufacturing, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Joint decline in HOUST and INDPRO occurs in 35% of cases but S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 40% of those instances.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles, federal funds rate exceeding 5.0% signals aggressive policy action that reduces liquidity and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: During monetary tightening cycles, FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0% in 60% of cases but S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of those instances.
